text: いえのなか　まちや　みちにいる　ひとに　むかって　Ａボタンを　おすと　かいわが　できます。

structure.jp: いえのなか　まちや　みちにいる　ひとに　むかって
structure.en: facing a person who is inside a house, in a town or on a road
when you press the A Button

structure.jp: かいわが　できます。

patterns.name: 〜と (when)
patterns.explanation: と after a plain verb means 'when this happens, that follows'. おすと = 'when you press'.

patterns.name: verb + noun
patterns.explanation: A verb phrase put straight in front of a person or thing describes it. みちにいる　ひと = 'a person who is on a road'.

patterns.name: 〜にむかって
patterns.explanation: に with むかって means 'facing' or 'toward' something. ひとに　むかって = 'facing a person'.
